schist-bin on Omarchy

A Photoshop-fluent layered image editor that's actually open source.

Package data synced 2026-10-20 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install schist-bin on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add schist-bin. It is a 58.6 MB download (162.7 MB installed), version 0.15.0-2, licensed MIT. Layered image editor with PSD and Affinity support (binary release). Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install schist-bin on Omarchy

Schist is a layered image editor built in Rust with a plugin-first design, aimed at people who need real PSD and Affinity file compatibility on Linux without giving up source control. It ships dozens of brushes, selection and retouching tools, adjustment layers, and Photoshop-style filters, plus GPU-accelerated compositing, content-aware fill, liquify, and non-destructive editing. This package installs the prebuilt binary release instead of compiling from source.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add schist-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.15.0-2:
    pacman -Qi schist-bin

Open and use schist-bin

schist-bin is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql schist-bin | grep applications

schist-bin requirements and compatibility

Frequently asked questions

How do I install schist-bin on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add schist-bin. The download is 58.6 MB and it takes 162.7 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is schist-bin free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall schist-bin?

Run omarchy pkg drop schist-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does schist-bin depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: fontconfig, freetype2, hicolor-icon-theme, libxcb, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, vulkan-icd-loader, wayland. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is schist-bin a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for schist-bin.

Is schist-bin in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as schist-bin (version 0.15.0-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Infrawrench LLC makes it. Project site: https://github.com/Infrawrench/schist.
